senses.gloss: 2. स्तृ॑ m. (only in pl. nom. स्तृणस् [?] gen. स्तृणाम् [v.l. स्तॄनाम्] and instr. pl. स्तृ॑भिस्; cf. तृ॑ nom. pl. तारस्) a star (as the ‘light-strewer’ or [pl.] the ‘scattered ones’), RV.; Jyot.
a mark or star-like spot (on the forehead of a bull or cow), RV.
स्तृ [cf. Lat. stella; Germ. Stern; Eng. star; accord. to some for अस्-तृ (√ 2. अस्); cf. Gk. ἀστήρ, ἄστρον.]
स्तृणीषणि inf. (with prep. उप). See root.
स्तृ॑ति f. the act of bestrewing or covering, Vop.
स्तृ॑त्य mfn. to be struck down or overthrown, AitBr.
स्तृक्ष् (cf. √ तृक्ष्) cl. 1. P. स्तृक्षति, to go, Dhātup. xvii, 9.
स्तृह् or स्तॄह् (cf. √ तृह्) cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xxviii, 58) स्तृहति, to injure, do harm, Āpast.
स्तृह् or स्तॄह् (cf. √ तृह्) cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xxviii, 58) स्तृहति, to injure, do harm, Āpast.
